name: zhihu/web/ebook-search-v3
description: Searches Zhihu for ebooks matching a query term. Returns publication details including commodity IDs, SKU IDs, and direct product links.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme: # Zhihu Ebook Search API Searches Zhihu for ebooks that match a keyword. Each result gives the title, authors, description, cover image, publish time and the `commodity_id` of the ebook. It needs one input, `keyword`. ## Use cases - Build a list of Zhihu ebooks on a topic such as OpenAI, with titles, authors and cover images. - Collect `commodity_id` values to index ebooks in a catalog. - Track publication dates of ebooks about a subject over time. - Page through all matches for a keyword to compare how many ebooks cover it. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/ebook-search-v3" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"keyword": "OpenAI"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `keyword` | string | Yes | Search Keywords | | `limit` | string | No | Number of ebooks per page | | `offset` | string | No | Offset | | `search_hash_id` | string | No | Search Hash ID | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "ab_params": "dm_a1_abc=0;sb_nvip_ecpm=1;sb_zhiedu=1;sb_vip_tag=1;dm_ai_search_safe=1;dm_AI_ho…", "data": [ { "highlight": {}, "hit_labels": null, "id": 674492, "index": 0, "object": { "ab_id_list": [ "dm_a1_abc=0" ], "attached_info_bytes": "OrwECgtwbGFjZWhvbGRlchIgMDEzMWY4YmEzYjM5MGQyNGQxNGQzMDhhZGZlZGEzZTcYDyIGNjc0NDky…", "body": { "authors": [ { "bio": "", "icon": "", "name": "雷韦春", "url_token": "" } ], "description": "OpenAI API 是一个为开发者、企业和研究者打造的平台。通过这个 API，用户可以轻松地融合和应用最前沿的 AI 技术", "images": [ "https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-f22e1778a7fab84b1a2b9278761879ef.jpg?source=31184dd1" ], "play_icon": "", "publish_at": 1727417136, "show_author": "", "show_image": "", "title": "OpenAI API 接口应用实战" }, "card_type": "", "card_version": "1", "commodity_id": "120480981", "commodity_type": "publication", "footer": "" }, "type": "knowledge_ad" } ], "domain_info": { "first_category": "" }, "filter_items": null, "hit_labels": null, "is_brand_word": false, "is_koc_words": false, "item_in_view": [ { "index": 5, "token": "b62a7302…", "type": "user_survey" } ], "paging": { "is_end": false, "next": "https://api.zhihu.com/search_v3?advert_count=0&correction=1&filter_fields=%7B%27…" }, "pendant": null, "related_search_result": [], "search_action_info": { "attached_info_bytes": "OqQBEiAwMTMxZjhiYTNiMzkwZDI0ZDE0ZDMwOGFkZmVkYTNlN0oGb3BlbmFpUABYB2ABagZPcGVuQUlw…", "isfeed": false, "lc_idx": 9, "search_hash_id": "0131f8ba3b390d24d14d308adfeda3e7" } } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data[].object.commodity_id` | ID of the ebook as a string. Use it to identify the ebook across calls. | | `data[].object.commodity_type` | Kind of item. Here the value is `publication`. | | `data[].object.body.title` | Ebook title. Matched search terms are wrapped in `` tags. | | `data[].object.body.authors[].name` | Name of each author. Books with several authors return several rows. | | `data[].object.body.description` | Short description of the ebook. It is cut off for long texts and may contain `` tags around matched terms. | | `data[].object.body.images[]` | Cover image URLs for the ebook. | | `data[].object.body.publish_at` | Publish time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. | | `data[].index / data[].id` | Position of the result in the list, and a numeric ID for the result row. | | `paging.is_end / paging.next` | `is_end` is `false` when more results exist. `next` holds the URL for the next page. | | `search_action_info.search_hash_id` | Hash ID for this search. Send it back as `search_hash_id` on later pages. | ## Notes - Use `limit` for page size and `offset` to move through results. Both are sent as strings. - Pass the `search_hash_id` from `search_action_info` in follow-up page requests for the same keyword. - Strip the `` tags from `title` and `description` before showing them as plain text. - To find other Zhihu content on the same keyword, try [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3) or [Zhihu Video Search (V3)](/apis/zhihu/web/video-search-v3). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu AI Search Stream](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Returns streaming AI search results from Zhihu based on a query prompt. - [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail): Retrieves detailed information for a specific Zhihu answer using its numeric ID, including answer text, timestamps, and share links. - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse…
